summary.text: Mandy Steele is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House District 33 who has served since December 1, 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Steele co-founded the Fox Chapel Parks Conservancy.

paragraphs.text: Mandy Steele was born in O'Hara Township, Pennsylvania, and co-founded the Fox Chapel Parks Conservancy.
Steele assumed office on December 1, 2022, succeeding Carrie DelRosso.
In the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the Agriculture and Rural Affairs, Consumer Protection and Professional Licensure, Environmental Resources and Energy, and Game and Fisheries committees.
